validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: Confirmed real and under construction. P6722 is the '4' (second of two parallel) 56-inch trunk line in Package 5 of Aramco's Master Gas System Phase 3 (MGS-3), running EWPS-3 -> EWPS-4. MEED (independent) and IPLOCA (quoting the Bin Quraya award announcement, independent of MEED) both describe Package 5 as 'two 56" pipes between EWG 3 and 4 covering 2 lines of 85 km 56" in the existing corridor, scraper launchers and receivers, starting from BGCS 3 in Wasea and ending at EWPS 4 in Riyadh.' Tube & Pipe India and SICIM (each 200 + MGS/56 content present) independently confirm the 17-package, ~$10bn MGS-3 programme, construction started Q2 2024, completion Q4 2028. Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: Correctly recorded as gas transmission (Fuel=Gas, PipelineType=transmission); sources call them dry-gas transport/transmission trunk lines feeding industrial hubs (Shoaiba, Shoqaiq) by 2028 — not NGL, not gathering. DUPLICATE: NOT a duplicate. P6721 ('3', 83 km) and P6722 ('4', 83 km) are the two distinct parallel lines that together compose Package 5 (2 x ~85 km = ~170 km total, matching the IPLOCA '170 km' and MEED '166 km' Package-5 figures). Modeling them as two ProjectIDs is correct, not a double-count. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco (100%) confirmed — Aramco is the project sponsor in all sources. SPEC: Diameter 56 in confirmed by all sources. Status=construction confirmed (Q2 2024 start). StartYear1=2028 confirmed (in-service/completion Q4 2028). LENGTH CAVEAT: GEM records 83 km; the two corroborating award sources both state '85 km' per line. The ~2 km difference is immaterial and likely rounding/route-segmentation; not flagged as a spec concern but noted. LOCATION: GEM Location [ref] is blank; sources give endpoints BGCS-3 (Wasea, Eastern Province) -> EWPS-4 (Riyadh) for the Package-5 corridor — staged as a fill below. NOTE: gem.wiki read for leads only; not cited. Aramco.com ref in the worklist (aramcos-strategic-gas-expansion 25bn contract awards) ReadTimeout'd on verification (server-side timeout, not confirmed dead) so it is NOT included in proposed_refs; the verified MEED + IPLOCA pair fully supports the row.
